candidates.violated_requirement: The output match should be asserted only when the shift register value is exactly 8'b0111_0001. This mutation incorrectly requires the MSB to be 0 in addition to the exact pattern, causing false negatives when the pattern occurs with MSB=1.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires match to be asserted whenever a_tem matches the specific 8-bit pattern 8'b0111_0001, without additional conditions.
